questions: What are your contracted gas and electricity prices (€/MWh) and CO₂ price (€/t), including any electricity export tariff or time-varying rates? (If you do not know: Current defaults are gas €40/MWh, electricity €120/MWh, export €60/MWh and CO₂ €80/t; these would give only a provisional recommendation..)
final_reply:
The cheapest tested design that covers the tested winter geothermal outage costs EUR31.80/MWh: one doublet at 3025 m, gas-boiler heating, wet-tower electric cooling, co-produced-gas CHP, a 0.25 MW ORC and 15 MW electric standby. Capital cost is EUR25.21 million [R0585].

It meets all annual hard rules, agrees with GEMINI’s Solver at peak heating, and passes the winter geothermal-trip test [R0585, R0621]. The combined low-reservoir, higher-demand and winter-trip case fails the demand rules [R0623]. Boiler-failure resilience remains unverified.

The cheapest planned-outage alternative costs EUR3
